ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side of the figure gives two clock waveforms; CLK1 is a square wave and one period T_CLK1 is marked, and the waveform of CLK2 is delayed to the right relative to CLK1, with the delay marked as T_CLK1/5. The circuit on the right is a D-Latch; CLK1 is connected to the D input terminal, CLK2 is connected to the CK enable terminal, and the output is taken from the Q terminal and marked Output. Reasoning: Let the period be T. From the figure and the problem statement, the duty cycle of CLK1 is 50%, so its high-level interval can be taken as 0 to T/2. CLK2 is the signal obtained by delaying CLK1 by T/5, so its high-level interval is from T/5 to T/5 + T/2 = 7T/10. The D latch is transparent when CK=CLK2 is high and the propagation delay is 0, so the output Q follows D=CLK1 during the CLK2 high-level period. Thus the time when the output is high is the overlap of the CLK1 high-level interval and the CLK2 high-level interval, namely from T/5 to T/2, with duration T/2 - T/5 = 3T/10. Therefore the output duty cycle is (3T/10)/T × 100% = 30%.

method.method_draft: Let one period be T. From the text and timing diagram, CLK1 is high for T/2, e.g. from 0 to T/2. CLK2 is the latch-enable signal and is delayed by T/5, so its high interval is from T/5 to T/5 + T/2 = 7T/10. Since the latch is transparent only while CLK2 is high and D = CLK1, the output high interval is the overlap of CLK1 high and CLK2 high: from T/5 to T/2. Its duration is T/2 - T/5 = 3T/10, so the output duty cycle is 30%.

method.method_draft: Trace one normalized period T. Before CLK2 rises, the latch is opaque and Q holds its previous low value. At t = T/5, CLK2 goes high, opening the latch; at that moment CLK1 is still high, so Q immediately goes high. While CLK2 remains high, Q follows CLK1. At t = T/2, CLK1 falls, so Q falls to low. When CLK2 later falls at t = 7T/10, the latch closes while Q is already low and holds low until the next period. Thus Q is high only from T/5 to T/2, for 3T/10 of the period, giving 30%.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧给出了两路时钟波形 CLK1 和 CLK2。CLK1 为周期 T_CLK、50% 占空比的方波；CLK2 的波形相对 CLK1 向后延迟了 T_CLK/5，并且作为 D-Latch 的 CK 输入。右侧电路显示 CLK1 接到 D-Latch 的 D 输入，CLK2 接到 D-Latch 的 CK 输入，输出为 Q/Output。

推理：取一个归一化周期 T。CLK1 在 0 到 T/2 为高电平，在 T/2 到 T 为低电平。由于 CLK2 是 CLK1 延迟 T/5 得到的，所以 CLK2 在 T/5 到 T/5 + T/2 = 7T/10 为高电平。D-Latch 在 CK 高电平时透明，因此只有 CLK2 为高时，输出 Q 跟随输入 D，也就是跟随 CLK1。t < T/5 时锁存器不透明，输出保持前一周期末的低电平。t = T/5 时 CLK2 变高，锁存器打开，此时 CLK1 仍为高电平，所以 Q 立即变高。t = T/2 时 CLK1 变低，而 CLK2 仍为高电平，所以 Q 跟随变低。t = 7T/10 时 CLK2 变低，锁存器关闭，此时 Q 已经为低电平，并继续保持低电平。因此 Q 只在 T/5 到 T/2 之间为高电平，高电平持续时间为 T/2 - T/5 = 3T/10。占空比 = (3T/10)/T × 100% = 30%。
